text:
nina (Design): quick review request — small tooltip shown beside the prompt input in the Console that shows an inline sample. current: `e.g. "Summarize this email in 3 bullets"` feels long and inconsistent with other examples. want a shorter, single-line microcopy that still teaches behavior (instruction + optional param). screenshot: https://redwood.ai/ui/inline-sample
omar (Eng): agree — the quote causes wrapping on mobile. we also render this inside an input helper so space is tight.
felix (PM): key goals: 1) teach user what a prompt looks like, 2) show optional parameter (like length), 3) fit one line. keep voice friendly but terse.
jin (A11y): accessibility: helper text must be read by screen readers and not be decorative. avoid punctuation that confuses SRs. prefer `Try: Summarize this email — 3 bullets` or `Example: Summarize this email (3 bullets)`.
lex (Docs): also think about consistency with docs examples which use sentence case and no punctuation at the end. translations will want the example phrase isolated.
i18n-bot: flagged: please wrap examples in a separate translatable token so localizers can move order. avoid embedded numeric abbreviations when possible.
nina (Design): tossing out four compact variants (aiming for <=40 chars):
1) Try: Summarize this email (3 bullets)
2) Example: Summarize this email — 3 bullets
3) Summarize this email (try: 3 bullets)
4) Summarize this email — short (3 bullets)
omar (Eng): 1 looks clean. dash in 2 may be read oddly by some screen readers. parens in 3 are okay. test: how many chars? 1 is 33 chars.
jin (A11y): vote for 1 or 3. wording `Try:` is an action prompt which is helpful. ensure SR reads the full phrase as one unit. add aria-describedby linking to input.
felix (PM): prefer `Try: Summarize this email (3 bullets)` — short and directive. also propose helper under input: `Tip: include desired length, e.g. "3 bullets"` — but keep it optional.
lex (Docs): suggestion: avoid smart quotes in helper. docs will reference the helper as `Try: Summarize this email (3 bullets)` exactly.
i18n-bot: note added: `Try:` should be part of the same string for translators, do not split.
nina (Design): ok final copy locked: `Try: Summarize this email (3 bullets)`
omar (Eng): implementation snippet for the input helper:
`<InputHelper id="prompt-sample" aria-describedby="prompt-input" text={"Try: Summarize this email (3 bullets)"} maxWidth={360} />`
omar (Eng): will clamp and add ellipsis at <320px; tests to ensure `Try:` prefix isn't truncated.
jin (A11y): i'll run the screen-reader pass after the PR. add `role="note"` on the helper so it's announced but not confusing during form navigation.
felix (PM): adding to release notes: "UX: tighter inline prompt sample for prompt editor"
nina (Design): thanks everyone — i'll push updated token to the component library and ping i18n for translation strings.
